# python-cqrs

> Документация по библиотеке python-cqrs. Паттерны CQRS, Saga, Mediator и Event Driven на Python.

python-cqrs is a Python framework for CQRS, Saga, Mediator, and event-driven
architectures. Use these docs for bootstrap, request/event handlers, transaction
outbox, transactional inbox, streaming, FastAPI/FastStream integrations, and distributed sagas.
The full text of every current page is in https://mkdocs.python-cqrs.dev/llms-full.txt
